source_caption:
🎥🎬: Batman: Knightfall

Gotham’s criminals unite under the leadership of Bane, a brilliant and powerful enemy who wants to break Batman both physically and psychologically. After releasing Arkham Asylum’s most dangerous villains, Bane pushes Batman into a relentless battle across the city, draining the hero of his strength.

Using his intelligence and patience, Bane discovers Batman’s limits and delivers a devastating defeat that leaves Bruce Wayne unable to continue as the Dark Knight. While Gotham struggles without its protector, a new figure takes up the mantle of Batman with a much darker approach.

Bruce must overcome his injuries, rebuild himself, and return to reclaim Gotham while proving that Batman is more than just a symbol of fear—it is a symbol of hope.

source_details.synopsis: Batman: Knightfall is an American adult animated superhero film trilogy featuring Batman, and based on the DC Comics story arc Batman: Knightfall (1993–1994) itself consisting of three storylines. The films were directed by Jeff Wamester from a script by Jeremy Adams and stars Anson Mount, Michael Mando and Pablo Schreiber. They are installments of the DC Universe Animated Original Movies series. The first installment, Batman: Knightfall – Part 1: Knightfall, details a terrorist campaign launched against Gotham City by Bane, an escaped convict from a Caribbean prison.
